source: Http2StreamWriteStallHandler resets an HTTP/2 stream (RST_STREAM CANCEL) whose response has data waiting in the flow controller that its client took none of for responseWriteStallTimeoutMillis, here a client that never returns flow-control window, and counts it in mock_server_response_write_stalls_total{protocol=http2,scope=stream} (MetricsTest#countsResponseWriteStallsUnderTheirProtocolAndScope)

steps.note: a 1 MB response on a stream whose client never returns window: the first 65535 bytes, then a reset

mask.reason: only the series this scenario drives; the rest are pinned by metrics.json
